Implemented the Codex empty-response fix.

- Preserves streamed delta text when `response.completed` contains no output.
- Supports valid `response.output_text.done`-only responses.
- Applies equivalent fallbacks to explicit streaming mode without duplicating normal deltas.
- Added regression tests for sparse completion and done-only responses.

Files changed: [codex.go](/private/tmp/luban-agent-benchmark-work/repos/danielmiessler__Fabric-2098/codex/internal/plugins/ai/codex/codex.go), [codex_test.go](/private/tmp/luban-agent-benchmark-work/repos/danielmiessler__Fabric-2098/codex/internal/plugins/ai/codex/codex_test.go).

`gofmt` and `git diff --check` pass. Tests could not run because Go 1.25.1 is unavailable locally; the installed Go 1.21.5 is too old, and the toolchain download was blocked.
